about: A recommendation that turns its claim's AND into OR does not follow; the same recommendation with AND does.

findings.title: Rebate guide
findings.content: Rebate guide. If your home has a heating load over 40,000 BTU/hr and is in a cold climate with a design temperature below 5°F, pair a heat pump with a gas furnace (dual-fuel) to maximize rebates and comfort.

claims.claim: A home with a heating load over 40,000 BTU/hr in a cold climate with a design temperature below 5°F should pair a heat pump with a gas furnace (dual-fuel).

recommendations.when: the heating load is over 40,000 BTU/hr or the design temperature is below 5°F
the heating load is over 40,000 BTU/hr and the design temperature is below 5°F
